q: effect to place a Digimon card with [Pulsemon] in its text and no digivolution cards on top of my security stack?

a: After you place it on top of the security stack, the Tamer card will become the top card and it will remain in the battle area as a Tamer.
q: effect to place a Digimon card with [Pulsemon] in its text that has just 1 Tamer card under it on top of the security stack?

Effect: [Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Pulsemon] in its text among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
・By placing the top stacked card of 1 of your level 4 or higher Digimon with [Pulsemon] in its text as your top security card, gain 2 memory.
Security Effect: [Security] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Pulsemon] in its text among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
